What's actually wrong with it — duplicates, stale tickets, missing priority, wrong labels? "Sort out" could mean a few different things and I don't want to start closing/reordering/relabeling stuff based on a guess.

If you mean something specific like "close anything untouched in 60+ days and re-tag the rest by priority," say so and I'll run it. Otherwise give me a pointer to what's bugging you and I'll take a pass.
